prompts.icon: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: square addon listing icon for ShatterBar, an independent World of Warcraft profession utility for disenchanting, prospecting, milling, and lockboxes. Primary request: create one polished original fantasy game addon emblem: a large luminous faceted crystal at the instant of shattering, its central angular silhouette surrounded by only a few bold separated shards, sitting above a short understated row of three square stone/metal action-bar tiles. Strong readable silhouette at 64 px; centered with generous edge padding; moody dark background; jewel-like cyan and violet light, tasteful gold bevel accents, hand-painted high quality fantasy UI material. Square 1:1 composition, single finished icon only. No lettering, no numbers, no watermark, no Blizzard or Warcraft logo, no imitation of an existing addon mark. Make the crystal dominant and the little action bar secondary. Opaque dark background.
prompts.banner: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: wide promotional header for ShatterBar, a World of Warcraft profession addon. Use the attached generated square icon only as a reference for the original ShatterBar identity: cyan-violet shattering crystal with restrained gold accents and a compact row of three profession tiles. Make a finished wide 2:1 banner. Place the crystal-and-three-tiles emblem on the left third, with dark breathing room. On the right, very large clear elegant fantasy serif lettering reading exactly "ShatterBar", in pale ivory with restrained gold edge, and beneath in smaller highly readable lettering exactly "Break it down. Keep it simple." Deep near-black navy background with subtle violet magic haze. Cohesive polished painterly fantasy UI artwork, strong contrast, generous safe margins. No game logos, no extra text, no watermark. Preserve the icon reference identity but compose a true wide header, not a square pasted on a rectangular frame.
